catalog.container_strategy: Preserve exact source and notices in immutable prepared materials. A reference adapter does not install or start this resource.
catalog.purpose: Source reference for real LLVM builder flags, staged compiler builds, sanitizer and test-suite recipes. Do not automatically start upstream workers, watchers or services.
qualification_gaps: Source qualification does not demonstrate build, container, runtime service or dependency closure readiness.
requirements.txt contains -e file:///home/llvm-buildbot/buildbot/master and therefore is not portable or a complete reproducible dependency closure.
Buildbot, worker credentials, notification settings and a database require a separate explicitly configured deployment. Do not copy upstream infrastructure-specific identities or paths.
catalog.size_basis: Complete HTTPS payload measured locally; source logical bytes sum regular archive members and exclude filesystem allocation, external dependencies and build trees.
catalog.title: LLVM Zorg buildbot recipes and infrastructure

recipe.external_data_requirements: External benchmark datasets, generated inputs and native dependency closure are outside this original repository material qualification

material_profile_dependency_mapping.build: Original native/tool build dependencies preserved but not executed by material installation
material_profile_dependency_mapping.run: Original native/tool runtime dependencies preserved but not qualified by availability
material_profile_dependency_mapping.system: Only apt.python3 is used for all-file material verification

locations.label: Complete declared main-archive materials
locations.purpose: Independent upstream files, including original notices, tests, examples, inputs, answers and reference material present in the fixed archive.

notes: The material package retains every original file and safe symbolic link in the exact fixed main archive; full content checks run on independent installations.

Canonical source fields remain unchanged. recipe/acquisition_lock and recipe/input-audit.json explicitly resolve only previously unknown SHA-256 and byte count from the same fixed URL/commit and bind the baseline definition hash.

Availability does not compile or execute corpus programs, generate missing runtime inputs, validate a numerical oracle or produce an official benchmark score. Dataset interfaces, OCI and physical-target execution need separate evidence.
Original license labels and all upstream notices remain unchanged; download and material verification do not grant license clearance.
The exact main repository Git tree has zero gitlinks. Nested vendored .gitmodules files are preserved as upstream metadata; their external test/build dependencies are not installed or qualified.

This explicit material variant only requires Python for byte, mode and link verification. The complete original build/run/system dependency contract is preserved in baseline-package.json and recipe.material_profile_original_dependencies; that native execution contract is not qualified by this profile.
usage.summary: Source reference for real LLVM builder flags, staged compiler builds, sanitizer and test-suite recipes. Do not automatically start upstream workers, watchers or services.
